name: YuE
tagline: Open-source full-song music generation model producing structured verse-chorus tracks with expressive vocals offline.
real_test_summary: Tested quantized YuE checkpoints locally to generate full-length vocal tracks from structured lyrics. Separates vocal and instrumental stems cleanly offline.
pros: Produces coherent full-song structure with distinct verse and chorus sections
Outputs separate vocal and accompaniment stems for easy mixing
Apache-2.0 open-source license with no generation limits
cons: Slower generation speed than diffusion-based audio models
Requires 8GB-12GB VRAM with quantization for practical runtimes
